# Common ordinary pressure maximum, full cycle cancellation, and pressure loss

**Full Collatz remains open.** This checkpoint pursued three global closing attacks after refreshing PR175/176/177/178/180/185. It proves a common-root reduction with no path-length cap, formalizes complete numerical cancellation transport, and derives exact original-source pressure-loss accounting. It does not prove escape exclusion or unrestricted positive-cycle exclusion.

**Published checkpoint:** `b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590`  
**Tree:** `5114a10d1e9107f24e5f3bc6f98fb2c0f0e2b2f1`  
**Parent:** `aa12c13601cacec2c8496f1349b4947457dc1b45`

[Scientific entry point](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590/research/closure-round2-20261123/README.md) · [Source ledger](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590/research/closure-round2-20261123/SOURCES.json) · [Verification and review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round2/README.md)

## Why this change

The unrestricted finite witness optimizer already includes every complete capturing source, so a cheaper-source search alone does not pay the original target's missing descent. Polynomial denominator growth still leaves numerical cancellation at the distinguished evaluation. Haar pressure contraction still leaves an ordinary atomic eigenmeasure on a hypothetical escaping component. The new work keeps those three precise targets.

## 1. One root for every forward and incoming coefficient inequality

On an escaping component of positive odd ternary units, put `r(n)=Lambda_infinity(n)/n`, using the pinned elementary positive-product theorem. The bound `0<r(n)<=1/n` implies an attained maximum at an actual ordinary integer `m`. This same root maximizes every pressure atom `r(n)^s`, independently of `s>1`.

The exact edge equation `2^a(n) r(n)=3r(U(n))` gives, simultaneously at that same root:

- `2^A < 3^h` for every nonempty actual forward odd prefix from `m`.
- `3^h < 2^A` for every nonempty positive odd unit inverse prefix ending at `m`.

Here `h` is the complete odd depth and `A` the total gap. There is no depth cap, restricted gap alphabet, or new choice of root per word. Every positive odd-clock future state is strictly greater than `m`. Its local residues lie in `{7,19,23,31} mod36`; the class 23 is retained because the apparent incoming gap-one source is outside the unit domain.

If `m_0` is the ordinary component minimum, the written bound also gives

`m_0 <= m <= m_0 exp((160/3) m_0^(-1/40))`.

[Written derivation and failed closing step](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590/research/closure-round2-20261123/SOURCE_CLOSURE.md) · [TwoSidedPressure.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590/research/closure-round2-20261123/TwoSidedPressure.lean)

**Formal boundary:** Lean proves maximum attainment, guarded actual path balance, and the common-root theorem from explicit positivity, `n*r(n)<=1`, and edge-balance hypotheses. The infinite product construction, its positivity and the quantitative floor bound remain written deductions from the pinned ordinary orbit-count source. The selected root is not identified with the least global counterexample.

**Unresolved:** the two path restrictions have not been proved inconsistent. Tests supported on the known finite basin graph vanish on a disjoint escaping component; their pressure identity is `0=0`. An arithmetic construction contradicting one of the two restrictions is still needed.

## 2. Numerical cancellation at the complete denominator

For complete shortcut words `w=u 0^h 1 v`, `w'=u 1 0^h v`, and their actual positive denominator `D=2^A-3^p`,

`C(w)-C(w') = 2^|u| 3^|v|_1 (2^h-1)`.

If `D` divides `C(w)`, then exactly

`gcd(D,C(w')) = gcd(D,2^h-1)`.

The new module derives the two/three coprimalities from the word's own denominator. An adjacent exchange retains reduced denominator exactly `D`, including all prime powers. The `D=1` exception remains integral and is explicitly tested.

The written global attack gives disjoint closed adjacent-exchange neighborhoods under `D>2*3^floor(A/2)`, and reconstructs a zero-residue word from the complement of any cyclic window of length `h` under `D>3^h`. These are whole-fibre injections, but their bounds do not reach `N_0(A,p)<A`. They are not claimed to improve the prior asymptotic polynomial census.

[Complete arithmetic and global attempt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590/research/closure-round2-20261123/CYCLE_CANCELLATION.md) · [CycleCancellation.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590/research/closure-round2-20261123/CycleCancellation.lean)

The balanced-unit defect normalization retains the full quotient. The primary Grieve–Wang and Corvaja–Zannier statements were checked directly; the proposed all-word encodings do not satisfy their fixed-dimension, fixed-degree and coefficient-height requirements. No general gcd theorem is substituted for unrestricted Collatz cancellation.

## 3. Exact original-source pressure-loss accounting

For the ordinary reference `sigma_s=sum n^(-s) delta_n` and the positive loss `d_s=sum n^(-s)(1-lambda(n)^s) delta_n`,

`sigma_s P_s = sigma_s-d_s`,

and for every nonnegative integrable seed,

`sum_(k>=0) d_s(P_s^k f) = sigma_s(f)-mu_infinity,s(f)`.

The residual is exactly the sum of the canonical escaping-component measures. The rational-pole calculation gives a height-weighted countable-family budget and a complete Green potential finite at every ordinary root, including periodic roots with their repeated-hit factor retained. It is integrable against the loss measure and, for `1<s<2`, Haar.

Against a retained escaping component, the same Green integral is infinite: one unchanged ordinary source contributes the same positive amount at every later endpoint. This is the precise boundary of the attempted pole-majorant closure. The local parameter window `log_2(3)<s<2` is nonempty, but no globally integrable majorant or same-law critical collision upper bound was obtained.

[Pressure calculation and boundary](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590/research/closure-round2-20261123/ESCAPE_CLOSURE.md)

## Verification actually run

| Check | Result and scope |
|---|---|
| Fresh Lean compile | Unchanged carry dependency, both new modules, and the complete audit all exited zero with warnings as errors |
| New public statements | 6 cycle-cancellation statements and 12 common-root/path statements; all 18 audited |
| Axioms | Only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`; no admitted proof or custom Collatz axiom |
| Exact replay | Both Python programs passed normally and under `-O`, producing identical results |
| Complete-word controls | 6,411 positive complete words through length 12; 31,865 moving-letter identities; cyclic-cut and window controls |
| Retained-source controls | Exact finite pressure telescope, endpoint collisions, repeated periodic visits, and detection of deleted repeats |
| Mutation controls | Corrupt carries rejected; forged `D=1` passes basic unit/zero-residue checks and is rejected by full-denominator binding |
| Internal review | Separate reconstructions of the cycle algebra, common-root theorem and pressure accounting; exact source hashes retained |

[Lean receipt and axiom output](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round2/LEAN_RECEIPT.json) · [Exact receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round2/EXACT_RECEIPT.json) · [Source bindings](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round2/SOURCE_BINDING.json)

These finite formal and computational checks do not extend to every written infinite argument or prove Collatz.

### Exact published-head checkout check

After publication, fetched the branch and created a fresh detached complete checkout at the published commit above. Ran `python -X utf8 -B tools/validate.py` with its receipt outside that checkout. All five required commands exited zero:

1. `tools/check_integration_state.py`
2. `tools/check_review_integration.py`
3. `tools/check_review_integration.py --self-test`
4. `tools/test_integrity_portability.py`
5. `reports/prepublic-2026-09-05/integration-d/check_followup.py --self-test`

Observed **463 tracked files**, tree `5114a10d1e9107f24e5f3bc6f98fb2c0f0e2b2f1`, and a clean checkout after execution. All **25** bound source/report hashes matched. All **34** pre-existing tracked Lean files matched the preceding published checkpoint. Both new proof modules and their dependency matched the exact freshly compiled bytes. Remote ref, PR head, tree and sole parent were read back after the push.

The in-repository `CHECKOUT_VALIDATION.json` records the clean local science checkpoint before receipt files were added; the exact published-head run above includes those receipt files. Repository integrity checks are not mathematical verification.

## Continuity and remaining target

The [preceding high-variance packet](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590/research/high-variance-20261123/README.md) and its original evidence remain available. The prior PR description is archived in [PR182_BEFORE.json](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b78819e95ee7d39f02022de991b42217821e7590/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round2/PR182_BEFORE.json).

The strongest unresolved steps remain: contradict the simultaneous coefficient constraints at the common ordinary root; exclude unrestricted complete-denominator integer cycles; or prove the required upper bound against the actual retained escape law. No merge or change to the PR's base/draft status is part of this checkpoint.
